warnings: Rounding: Engine uses half-up cent rounding for coinsurance calculations; this is a convention, not an extracted policy fact.
Benefit B2: Referral requirement is based on plan-wide question; self-referral exception details are not fully specified and should be confirmed in plan documents.
Benefit B9: Non-preferred brand drugs cost-sharing aligns with preferred brand only when approved through formulary exception; condition included, but exception process details are not in SBC.
Benefit B12: Outpatient mental/behavioral health has additional group visit copays and substance abuse copays not compiled (see coverage gaps).
Out-of-network coverage is generally not covered; emergency services have out-of-network cost sharing but are omitted due to unsupported arithmetic and balance billing uncertainty.
coverage_gaps: Out-of-network deductible and OOP max: not specified in SBC, network omitted.
Out-of-network balance billing: generic warning about balance billing present, but no explicit protection; set to null. Claims require independent contract evidence.
Emergency medical transportation: per-trip copay $250 both in and out of network; omitted because per-trip rate not supported (engine supports per-day or per-service, not per-trip).
Out-of-network emergency room care: $350 copay same as in-network, but out-of-network network structure not compiled; potential balance billing.
Out-of-network urgent care: temporarily outside service area $40/visit; not compiled due to unsupported condition.
Facility fee (outpatient surgery): $190/procedure not compiled because per-procedure rate not supported.
Physician/surgeon fees (outpatient surgery): Not Applicable, included in facility fee; no separate benefit.
Facility fee (hospital stay): $375/day up to 5 days; per-day multi-day cap omitted.
Physician/surgeon fee (hospital stay): Not Applicable, included in facility fee; no separate benefit.
Inpatient mental/behavioral health: $375/day up to 5 days; per-day multi-day cap omitted.
Childbirth/delivery professional services: Not Applicable, included in facility fee; no separate benefit.
Childbirth/delivery facility services: $375/day up to 5 days; per-day multi-day cap omitted.
Home health care: $30/visit with per-visit, per-day, per-year limits; omitted due to per-visit rate and multiple caps.
Rehabilitation services: split outpatient $40/visit and inpatient $375/day up to 5 days; omitted due to split in/outpatient costs and per-day cap.
Habilitation services: split outpatient $40/visit and inpatient $375/day up to 5 days; omitted.
Skilled nursing care: $150/day up to 5 days with 100-day limit/year; per-day cap omitted.
Durable medical equipment: 20% coinsurance; included? not compiled because no other details; prior authorization required.
Hospice service: No charge; not compiled because no service category details in SBC.
Children's eye exam, glasses, dental check-up: No charge; omitted due to age-specific and limitations.
Specialty drugs (Tier 4): 20% coinsurance up to $250/prescription; omitted due to per-prescription cap unsupported.
Preferred brand drugs mail order: $120/prescription up to 100-day supply; omitted due to mail order variant.
Generic drugs mail order: $36/prescription up to 100-day supply; omitted.
Non-preferred brand drugs mail order: $120/prescription with exception; omitted.
Outpatient mental/behavioral health group visit: $20/group; omitted due to group visit variant.
Substance abuse group visit: $5/group; omitted.
Other outpatient mental/behavioral health services: No charge; omitted due to lack of service category details.
Maternity care: tests and services described elsewhere; no standalone benefit.
Preventive care: services without cost sharing, but full list not in SBC.
Acupuncture, bariatric surgery, abortion: listed as other covered services with limitations; no cost sharing details.

Excluded services: chiropractic, cosmetic surgery, adult dental, hearing aids, infertility, long-term care, non-emergency care when traveling outside U.S., routine eye care (adult), routine foot care, weight loss programs, private-duty nursing.
Partial source review: sections were selected locally; omitted services require review and have no executable rules.
Network out omitted: deductible or OOP limit is not established. Claims in that network require separate review, including emergency exceptions.
